name: app.R
content:
# Interactive explorer for the Oʻahu electricity study (pre-v1.01). # Runs as a serverless shinylive site; data in data/ is generated by # build/build_explorer_data.py from the full solve fleet. library(shiny) library(bslib) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(ggplot2) library(readr) library(jsonlite) library(scales) library(plotly) scen <- read_csv("data/scenarios.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) gen <- read_csv("data/generation.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) costs <- read_csv("data/costs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) hourly <- read_csv("data/dispatch_hourly.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) meta <- fromJSON("data/meta.json") TECH_COLORS <- c( "Oil" = "#8c564b", "LNG" = "#7f7f7f", "Waste-to-energy" = "#bcbd22", "Geothermal (EGS)" = "#d62728", "Onshore wind" = "#1f77b4", "Offshore wind" = "#17becf", "Utility solar" = "#ff7f0e", "Distributed solar (netted)" = "#ffbb78", "Distributed solar (modeled)" = "#f7e08a", "Battery storage" = "#2ca02c", "Other" = "#c7c7c7" ) TECH_ORDER <- names(TECH_COLORS) HOUR_COLORS <- c( "Geothermal" = "#756bb1", "Waste-to-energy" = "#7f7f7f", "Thermal (oil/LNG)" = "#843c39", "Wind" = "#5fa2ce", "Utility solar" = "#f2c744", "Rooftop solar" = "#f7e08a", "Battery discharge" = "#2ca02c" ) OILS <- c("Market 10th percentile", "Brent futures", "EIA reference", "Market 90th percentile") # solar_mult is relative to the study baseline (1.2x mainland ATB), so the # premiums over mainland costs are 20% / 80% / 104% SOLAR_LABELS <- c("1" = "20% Hawaiʻi premium", "1.5" = "80% Hawaiʻi premium", "1.7" = "104% Hawaiʻi premium") TRAJS <- unique(scen$trajectory) CONFIG_ORDER <- scen |> distinct(config_label) |> pull(config_label) # scenario dropdown choices: plain-English label -> scenario id SCEN_CHOICES <- local({ s <- scen |> arrange(short_label) setNames(s$scenario, s$short_label) }) desc_of <- function(id) scen$description[scen$scenario == id][1] short_of <- function(id) scen$short_label[scen$scenario == id][1] axis_selectors <- function(id, mult = TRUE) { tagList( selectInput(paste0(id, "_traj"), "Rooftop trajectory", TRAJS, selected = "Conservative rooftop (base)"), selectInput(paste0(id, "_oil"), "Oil-price case", intersect(OILS, unique(scen$oil_label)), selected = "EIA reference"), if (mult) selectInput(paste0(id, "_mult"), "Utility solar cost", local({ sm <- sort(unique(scen$solar_mult)) setNames(sm, SOLAR_LABELS[as.character(sm)]) }), selected = 1.0), selectInput(paste0(id, "_screen"), "Land screen", unique(scen$land_screen), selected = "Reference"), selectInput(paste0(id, "_basis"), "Solar/battery cost basis", unique(scen$solar_basis), selected = "ATB Moderate") ) } filter_axes <- function(df, input, id, mult = TRUE) { out <- df |> filter(trajectory == input[[paste0(id, "_traj")]], oil_label == input[[paste0(id, "_oil")]], land_screen == input[[paste0(id, "_screen")]], solar_basis == input[[paste0(id, "_basis")]]) if (mult) out <- filter(out, solar_mult == input[[paste0(id, "_mult")]]) out } ui <- page_navbar( title = "Oʻahu Electricity Futures — results explorer", theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "flatly"), header = tags$div( class = "alert alert-warning py-1 px-3 mb-0 small", sprintf(paste0("Pre-release (%s), open for comment — results may change. ", "Data: %s solved scenarios, %s at 0.1%% optimality; ", "generated %s."), meta$version, meta$scenarios, meta$refined_010, meta$generated_hst) ), nav_panel("System costs", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( axis_selectors("c"), checkboxInput("c_delta", "Show difference vs no-new-plant", TRUE), checkboxInput("c_conv", "Charge conversion capital ($0.45B) to conversion cases", TRUE) ), card(card_header("Total 2027–2050 system cost (present value, billion 2024$)"), uiOutput("cost_plot_ui")), card(card_header("Table"), tableOutput("cost_table")) ) ), nav_panel("Generation mix", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( axis_selectors("g"), uiOutput("g_config_ui"), radioButtons("g_metric", "Metric", c("Energy (GWh/yr)" = "energy_gwh", "Capacity (MW)" = "capacity_mw", "Emissions (kt CO2/yr)" = "emissions_tco2")) ), card(card_header(textOutput("g_title")), uiOutput("g_desc"), plotOutput("mix_plot", height = 460)) ) ), nav_panel("Compare", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( selectInput("cmp_a", "Scenario A", SCEN_CHOICES, selected = "nlv2b_C4_NOTHERMAL_refbrent"), selectInput("cmp_b", "Scenario B", SCEN_CHOICES, selected = "nlv2b_wb_C6_LNG500_refbrent") ), card(card_header(textOutput("cmp_head")), uiOutput("cmp_desc"), plotOutput("cmp_plot", height = 430)), card(tableOutput("cmp_table")) ) ), nav_panel("Emissions", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( axis_selectors("e"), uiOutput("e_configs_ui") ), card(card_header("Combustion CO2 by period (Mt/yr; excludes upstream methane)"), plotOutput("em_plot", height = 440)) ) ), nav_panel("Hourly dispatch", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( selectInput("h_scen", "Scenario", SCEN_CHOICES[SCEN_CHOICES %in% unique(hourly$scenario)], selected = "nlv2b_C4_NOTHERMAL_refbrent"), radioButtons("h_day", "2035 sample day", setNames(names(meta$sample_days), paste0(unlist(meta$sample_days), " — ", names(meta$sample_days)))) ), card(card_header("Hourly generation and demand (MW), 2035"), uiOutput("h_desc"), plotOutput("hr_plot", height = 460)) ) ), nav_panel("All solves", layout_sidebar( sidebar = sidebar( checkboxGroupInput("a_oil", "Oil cases", intersect(OILS, unique(scen$oil_label)), selected = intersect(OILS, unique(scen$oil_label))), checkboxGroupInput("a_traj", "Trajectories", TRAJS, selected = TRAJS) ), card(card_header(sprintf( "Every solved scenario (%s) — hover for details", meta$scenarios)), plotlyOutput("all_plot", height = 560)) ) ), nav_panel("About", uiOutput("about")) ) server <- function(input, output, session) { # ---- System costs ---- cost_data <- reactive({ d <- filter_axes(scen, input, "c") shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, "No solved scenarios match this selection.")) if (input$c_conv) d <- mutate(d, total_cost_bn = total_cost_bn + conv_capital_bn) # collapse the JERA capital band: bar at bare-EPC-to-+20% midpoint d |> group_by(config_label) |> summarise(lo = min(total_cost_bn), hi = max(total_cost_bn), mid = (lo + hi) / 2, n = n(), .groups = "drop") }) # size the bar chart to the number of configurations so nothing is cramped output$cost_plot_ui <- renderUI({ plotOutput("cost_plot", height = max(480, 70 * nrow(cost_data()) + 130)) }) output$cost_plot <- renderPlot({ d <- cost_data() base <- d$mid[d$config_label == "No new fuel plant"] if (input$c_delta && length(base) == 1) { d <- mutate(d, mid = mid - base, lo = lo - base, hi = hi - base) ylab <- "vs no-new-plant (billion 2024$)" } else ylab <- "billion 2024$ (PV 2027)" ggplot(d, aes(reorder(config_label, mid), mid)) + geom_col(fill = "#31708c", width = 0.65) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f", mid), vjust = ifelse(mid >= 0, -0.5, 1.3)), size = 3.4) + coord_flip() + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = "Whiskers: JERA capital, bare-EPC to +20%, where both are solved.") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) }) output$cost_table <- renderTable({ cost_data() |> transmute(Configuration = config_label, `Total ($B)` = sprintf("%.2f", mid), `Band` = ifelse(hi - lo > 1e-6, sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", lo, hi), "—")) }) # ---- Generation mix ---- output$g_config_ui <- renderUI({ opts <- filter_axes(scen, input, "g") |> pull(config_label) |> unique() selectInput("g_config", "Configuration", opts, selected = intersect("No new fuel plant", opts)[1]) }) g_scen <- reactive({ req(input$g_config) d <- filter_axes(scen, input, "g") |> filter(config_label == input$g_config, jera_capital == "bare-EPC") shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) >= 1, "No solved scenario matches this selection.")) d$scenario[1] }) output$g_title <- renderText(short_of(g_scen())) output$g_desc <- renderUI({ div(class = "px-3 small", p(class = "mb-1", desc_of(g_scen())), p(class = "text-muted mb-0", paste("Model cell:", g_scen()))) }) output$mix_plot <- renderPlot({ d <- gen |> filter(scenario == g_scen()) |> mutate(value = .data[[input$g_metric]] / ifelse(input$g_metric == "emissions_tco2", 1000, 1), tech = factor(tech, levels = rev(TECH_ORDER))) if (input$g_metric != "capacity_mw") d <- filter(d, tech != "Battery storage") # drop empty techs (legend clutter) and never stack a negative band d <- d |> group_by(tech) |> filter(sum(abs(value)) > 0.5) |> ungroup() |> mutate(value = pmax(value, 0), tech = droplevels(tech)) # complete the grid: geom_area garbles the stack when a tech (e.g. LNG) # has no row in the periods where it is zero d <- d |> complete(period = sort(unique(d$period)), tech, fill = list(value = 0)) ggplot(d, aes(period, value, fill = tech)) + geom_area(alpha = 0.92) + scale_fill_manual(values = TECH_COLORS, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(d$period))) + labs(x = NULL, y = names(which(c( "Energy (GWh/yr)" = "energy_gwh", "Capacity (MW)" = "capacity_mw", "Emissions (kt CO2/yr)" = "emissions_tco2") == input$g_metric))) + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "right") }) # ---- Compare ---- output$cmp_head <- renderText({ a <- scen[scen$scenario == input$cmp_a, ] b <- scen[scen$scenario == input$cmp_b, ] sprintf("A: %s ($%.2fB) | B: %s ($%.2fB) | B − A: %+.2fB", short_of(input$cmp_a), a$total_cost_bn, short_of(input$cmp_b), b$total_cost_bn, b$total_cost_bn - a$total_cost_bn) }) output$cmp_desc <- renderUI({ div(class = "px-3 small", p(class = "mb-1", strong("A: "), desc_of(input$cmp_a)), p(class = "mb-1", strong("B: "), desc_of(input$cmp_b)), p(class = "text-muted mb-0", paste("Model cells:", input$cmp_a, "|", input$cmp_b))) }) output$cmp_plot <- renderPlot({ d <- gen |> filter(scenario %in% c(input$cmp_a, input$cmp_b), tech != "Battery storage") |> mutate(which = ifelse(scenario == input$cmp_a, "A", "B"), tech = factor(tech, levels = rev(TECH_ORDER)), energy_gwh = pmax(energy_gwh, 0)) |> group_by(tech) |> filter(sum(abs(energy_gwh)) > 0.5) |> ungroup() |> mutate(tech = droplevels(tech)) |> group_by(which) |> complete(period = sort(unique(gen$period)), tech, fill = list(energy_gwh = 0)) |> ungroup() ggplot(d, aes(period, energy_gwh, fill = tech)) + geom_area(alpha = 0.92) + facet_wrap(~which, ncol = 2) + scale_fill_manual(values = TECH_COLORS, name = NULL) + labs(x = NULL, y = "GWh per year") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) }) output$cmp_table <- renderTable({ gen |> filter(scenario %in% c(input$cmp_a, input$cmp_b), period == 2050, tech != "Battery storage") |> mutate(which = ifelse(scenario == input$cmp_a, "A", "B")) |> group_by(tech) |> summarise(`A 2050 GWh` = sum(energy_gwh[which == "A"]), `B 2050 GWh` = sum(energy_gwh[which == "B"]), .groups = "drop") |> filter(`A 2050 GWh` + `B 2050 GWh` > 0) }) # ---- Emissions ---- output$e_configs_ui <- renderUI({ opts <- filter_axes(scen, input, "e") |> pull(config_label) |> unique() checkboxGroupInput("e_configs", "Configurations", opts, selected = intersect(c("No new fuel plant", "JERA LNG plant, 500 MW"), opts)) }) output$em_plot <- renderPlot({ req(input$e_configs) picks <- filter_axes(scen, input, "e") |> filter(config_label %in% input$e_configs, jera_capital == "bare-EPC") shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(picks) > 0, "No solved scenarios match.")) d <- gen |> inner_join(select(picks, scenario, config_label), by = "scenario") |> group_by(config_label, period) |> summarise(mt = sum(emissions_tco2) / 1e6, .groups = "drop") ggplot(d, aes(period, mt, color = config_label)) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point(size = 2) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Mt CO2 per year", color = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") }) # ---- Hourly dispatch ---- output$h_desc <- renderUI({ div(class = "px-3 small", p(class = "mb-1", desc_of(input$h_scen)), p(class = "text-muted mb-0", paste("Model cell:", input$h_scen))) }) output$hr_plot <- renderPlot({ d <- hourly |> filter(scenario == input$h_scen, day == input$h_day) shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, "No hourly data for this scenario.")) stacks <- d |> filter(series %in% names(HOUR_COLORS)) |> mutate(series = factor(series, levels = rev(names(HOUR_COLORS)))) dem <- d |> filter(series == "Demand") chg <- d |> filter(series == "Battery charging") ggplot() + geom_area(data = stacks, aes(hour, mw, fill = series), alpha = 0.9) + geom_area(data = chg, aes(hour, mw), fill = "#2ca02c", alpha = 0.35) + geom_line(data = dem, aes(hour, mw), linewidth = 1.1) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) + scale_fill_manual(values = HOUR_COLORS, name = NULL) + labs(x = "Hour of day", y = "MW", caption = "Black line: demand. Shaded area below zero: battery charging.") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13) }) # ---- All solves ---- output$all_plot <- renderPlotly({ d <- scen |> filter(oil_label %in% input$a_oil, trajectory %in% input$a_traj) shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, "Nothing selected.")) set.seed(1) d <- d |> mutate(yn = as.numeric(factor(config_label, levels = CONFIG_ORDER)) + runif(n(), -0.18, 0.18), tip = paste0(short_label, "
$", sprintf("%.2f", total_cost_bn), "B
", scenario)) plot_ly(d, x = ~total_cost_bn, y = ~yn, color = ~oil_label, symbol = ~trajectory, text = ~tip, hoverinfo = "text", type = "scatter", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 8, opacity = 0.75)) |> layout(yaxis = list(tickvals = seq_along(CONFIG_ORDER), ticktext = CONFIG_ORDER, title = ""), xaxis = list(title = "Total system cost (billion 2024$, PV 2027)"), legend = list(orientation = "h")) }) # ---- About ---- output$about <- renderUI({ tagList( div(class = "container py-4", style = "max-width: 780px", h3("About this explorer"), p(sprintf(paste0( "Every chart is drawn from %s solved scenarios of the Oʻahu ", "capacity-expansion study (Switch 2.0.9/CPLEX), release %s, ", "data generated %s at repository commit %s."), meta$scenarios, meta$version, meta$generated_hst, meta$commit)), p(HTML(paste0( "The report, methods, inputs, and full scenario definitions are in the ", "", "public repository. Comments are invited during the pre-release ", "window — see COMMENT_POLICY.md there."))), h5("Conventions"), tags$ul( tags$li("All dollars are real 2024$; totals are present values of", " 2027–2050 system cost discounted to 2027 at 3 percent."), tags$li("Rooftop (distributed) solar and storage are netted out of", " load in the model; the 'distributed solar (netted)' series", " shown in mix charts is reconstructed for display from each", " trajectory's grid-visible capacity."), tags$li("Thermal generation is split between oil and LNG in", " proportion to fuel energy use; emissions are split by the", " same shares (an approximation)."), tags$li("Conversion scenarios exclude plant-conversion capital in", " the model; the optional $0.45B charge is a 2016-benchmark", " estimate (report Section 4.6)."), tags$li("Emissions are combustion CO2 only; upstream methane is", " discussed in the report."), tags$li("Scenarios at 0.25 percent optimality are being refined to", " 0.1 percent on an ongoing basis; small differences between", " scenarios can be within solver tolerance.")), p(class = "text-muted small", "First load takes a while: the app runs entirely in your browser", " (webR/shinylive); nothing is sent to a server.") ) ) }) } shinyApp(ui, server)

name: README.md
content:
# Interactive results explorer

A serverless Shiny app (compiled to WebAssembly with
[shinylive](https://posit-dev.github.io/r-shinylive/)) that lets readers
browse every solved scenario of the study: system costs, generation mixes,
emissions, and hourly dispatch. Modeled on the
[MIP results explorer](https://gschivley.github.io/MIP-shinylive/).

**Live site:** https://mikejrob.github.io/oahu-electricity-future/

## Pieces

- `app.R` — the app (R Shiny + bslib + ggplot2/plotly).
- `data/*.csv`, `data/meta.json` — compact extracts of the solve fleet,
  generated by `build/build_explorer_data.py` from the working repository
  (the full outputs never leave the cluster). One row per scenario in
  `scenarios.csv`; tidy scenario × period × technology tables behind the
  charts.
- `.github/workflows/deploy-explorer.yml` — on every push touching
  `explorer/`, GitHub Actions exports the app with
  `shinylive::export()` and deploys it to GitHub Pages.

## Refreshing the data

From the working repository root on Koa:

```bash
python3 build/build_explorer_data.py   # rewrites explorer/data/
./push_both.sh "Refresh explorer data"
```

The site rebuilds automatically a few minutes after the push.

## Coverage and conventions

The extracts cover the report-basis fleet only: the corrected
distributed-solar families (`nlv2b`/`nlv2s`/`nlv2a`) on the four market oil
paths plus the EIA reference. Legacy gross-load families and archived AEO
oil paths are excluded so no chart mixes netting conventions. Approximations
(thermal oil/LNG split, reconstructed netted-distributed series, the
optional conversion-capital charge) are documented in the app's About tab
and in the extractor's docstring.

## Local development

```r
shiny::runApp("explorer")          # needs shiny, bslib, dplyr, tidyr,
                                   # ggplot2, readr, jsonlite, scales, plotly
```
